description: This file defines the PoolPaymentMethod class, a specific payment method implementation that uses an internal virtual wallet (pool) for transactions within the Goteo project. It includes methods for checking pool status, initiating payments, and refunds, leveraging the Omnipay library.

classes.name: PoolPaymentMethod
classes.description: A payment method that utilizes an internal virtual wallet (pool) for transactions, using the Omnipay manual gateway. It manages pool status, initiates payments, and handles refunds within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway, which is 'Manual'.

methods.name: getPool
methods.description: Returns the user's pool object, fetching it if not already loaded.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the pool has sufficient funds for a given amount, indicating if the payment method is active.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a description of the pool's current amount for display purposes.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Performs a purchase using the pool funds, deducting amount, and initiating the authorization process via Omnipay.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Determines if the investment is in a state that allows a refund (charged).

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Attempts to refund the investment, dispatching refund events and updating the investment status.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates that this payment method is internal, not involving external gateways.
